title: Announcing Every + Finch: Less Time Moving Data, More Time Building
summary: Announcing Every + Finch: Less Time Moving Data and More Time Building
body_markdown:
High-growth startups accumulate new tools as quickly as they scale. First it’s a payroll solution, then benefits, 401(k), and compliance software—the list keeps growing.


As the stack builds, gaps appear when tools don’t talk to each other. Manual list uploads and data wrangling soon become commonplace, and every new hire or departure means updating systems by hand.


If there’s one thing growing startups don’t have to spare, it’s time for tedious data management. That’s why Every is thrilled to be partnering with[Finch](https://www.tryfinch.com/) , the unified API for payroll, HR, and benefits data.


## Introducing the Every + Finch Partnership


The new Every and Finch partnership enables Every customers to connect their payroll and HR data to[hundreds of apps built on Finch](https://www.tryfinch.com/integrations) . For those apps, Every is now also a supported integration.


Every’s AI-native finance and HR platform offers tooling for everything from banking to payroll, benefits, taxes, and compliance—all under one roof. Built for founders and operators at high-growth companies, Every simplifies and automates key back-office workflows so that you can scale with confidence.


Finch offers a single API that enables third-party apps to connect to payroll, HRIS, and ben admin systems. Before Finch, each app was required to negotiate partnerships and build custom integrations with each system of record. Now, Finch standardizes data from every provider into a single, unified format, making it possible for employers to connect their third-party apps to the employment systems of their choice in just a few clicks.


The Every and Finch partnership gives Every customers the ability to easily connect their account with the hundreds of applications that use Finch to power their integrations. For example, a founder using Every Payroll can sign up for a 401(k) provider, and instead of manually uploading an employee census, can simply choose "Connect to Every" and sign in. Their employee lists will autopopulate via Finch’s integration, and stay up to date with new hires and departures automatically.


“Wouldn’t it be great if all your products just worked together? If you didn’t have to spend hours downloading reports in one system and uploading them into another?” poses Ansel Parikh, co-founder and COO at Finch. “The new Every and Finch integration makes it possible to connect data in Every to your favorite third-party application in seconds, not hours.”


## Spend Less Time Moving Data with Every + Finch


Both Every and Finch are led by founders who know that building a startup requires moving smart and fast. Both platforms exist to take work off startup teams’ already-busy plates.


Every simplifies banking, payroll, and benefits so founders can spend less time in the back office. Finch removes integration pains across the payroll, HR, and benefits ecosystem so you can focus on using the best tools, not trying to stitch them together. The Every and Finch partnership is designed to continue this mission, enabling founders to focus on higher-value problems.


If you’re a founder thinking Every and Finch could help your team, you can book a time to connect with us[here](https://www.every.io/get-started) .


Building on Finch? Every is now available as an integration. You can[connect with Finch’s team](https://www.tryfinch.com/sales) to learn more.
